glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 才 + phonetic 士. In the oracle bone script and some of the bronze inscriptions, 才 is phonetically borrowed to represent this word; a phonetic 士 was added later. 士 eventually corrupted into 土 (“earth”).
senses: [zài] to exist; to be present; to be alive
[zài] to be at; to be in; to be located
